title: Foundations: Indie Rock - The Complete Guide
summary: What Indie Rock is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Indie Rock songs: Indie rock is guitar music made outside the majors: literate, angular, and allergic to cliché — from Velvet Underground drones to Interpol's post-punk and Vampire Weekend's Afro-pop jangle.

History: Indie labels (SST, Dischord, Rough Trade) sustained 1980s underground rock. The Strokes, Interpol, Arcade Fire, and Vampire Weekend made 2000s indie a commercial force without losing the ethos.

How the songs work: Indie Rock favors the keys of G, D, A, E, C. Common forms include Verse-chorus with an instrumental outro; Build-and-release without the grunge clichés. Players should master single-coil sparkle: telecasters and jaguars first, then interlocking guitar parts, no solos. Capo 2–3 for bright indie jangle.
